title: Fail linkage when training-grade capture is unavailable
narrative: Fangore needs graphs that require exact token capture to fail before expensive work when the active backend is evaluation-only. Accepts FineEnvs capture probing guidance[^fineenvs-capture].
implementation: `InferenceCapture`, `EvaluationOnlyCapture`, and `TrainingGradeCapture` in `mechaharness.inference_capture`, wired through `MechaHarnessConfig.get_inference_capture` and checked by `DefaultLinkageResolver` for `required_inference_capture`. `CliInstrumentor` verb `check_inference_capture` runs the preflight.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `training_grade_required.yaml`: hard `linkage_ok` and exact `codes_exactly`. Unit: `tests/test_inference_capture.py`.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — what gets recorded
